acceptedNearDuplicatePairs.reason: One uncancelled factorial factor versus two uncancelled factors creates a distinct simplification depth.
Fixing a unique letter versus one copy of a repeated letter changes the remaining multiplicities and denominator.
Zero is absent in one family and present in the other; the latter requires a separate zero-ending case.
The inverse unknown is total pool size n in one QL and selected-group size s in the other.
The inverse unknown is total pool size n in one QL and role count k in the other.
The inverse unknown is selected-group size s in one QL and role count k in the other.
Even-number formation without zero and odd-number formation with zero use different eligible endings and first-position constraints.
Even numbers with zero require a zero/non-zero-even case split; odd numbers do not.
APPLE has one repeated category whereas BALLOON has two repeated categories.
One repeated category is contrasted with three repeated categories and a substantially larger multiset.
Two repeated categories are contrasted with three repeated categories and different multiplicities.
The distinct-letter rank contract is contrasted with repeated-letter dictionary rank requiring multiset correction.

acceptedFixedStateReason: These are intentionally fixed expressions, fixed words, fixed contextual role counts or exact multiplicity patterns. Artificial numeric variation would weaken naturalness or change the contract being tested.
